where_to_source: public markets (palengke) in every barangay, Mercury Drug and Watsons pharmacies, Healthy Options health stores, community gardens (locally grown malunggay is ubiquitous)
dietary_norms: Predominantly Roman Catholic. No significant food taboos for most. Pork is the most common meat. Rice is eaten three times daily by most Filipinos. Vinegar (suka) and fish sauce (patis) are condiment staples. Coconut milk (gata) common in cooking.
